_comment: BAND-SPLIT. Band-local nodes for band5_stronghold_approach. `order` is this entry's index in the merged array and is the ONLY thing that decides merge position -- never file order, never band order. Existing entries keep the index they had before the split because the merged array order is the order harvest nodes are added to the scene tree. A new entry in this band takes an unused order in this band's reserved range 5000-5999, which no other band can collide with; do not renumber an existing one.
_comment_why_these: EXPEDITION-REST (prompt 61). This file was a comment-only stub with `nodes: []`, and so were band 4's and band 5's -- across the back ~4.4km of corridor there was no local harvest at all. Corridor scatter still yields wood/stone/fiber, so a camp was BUILDABLE; what was missing is anywhere it was worth stopping. `camp` costs wood 12 / stone 8 / fiber 10 and `creature_bed` wood 6 / fiber 8 (data/items/buildables.json), so a rest point has to be affordable from what is standing within a short walk of where the player actually is. These are sited beside VERIFIED positions -- each one sits within ~50m of a spawn cluster centre this band already ships, which are known-good on-route coordinates the world already stands creatures on. Positions are [x, z] only: D09 grounds everything by asking the world, so none of these can land inside geometry. TUNABLE, and deliberately three materials per stretch rather than one -- a clearing that yields only wood is a detour, not a camp.
